# Files that are allowed to contain a path-shaped string.
#
# The privacy job in .github/workflows/validate.yml fails the build when a
# tracked file contains an absolute path into a home directory. A vendored
# upstream file may legitimately contain a generic example in a comment.
#
# Every entry needs a reason. Keep this list as short as possible.
#
# config/scripts/webm.lua - vendored from ekisu/mpv-webm (MIT). The upstream
# comment explains the `[[...]]` path delimiter with the placeholder
# "C:\Users\John" and "/home/john". Those are invented example names in a
# comment, not a real path, and the file is kept byte-identical to upstream.
config/scripts/webm.lua
